item.question_text: Why does an AI management system carry obligations beyond the moment a system ships?

options.text: Because the criteria that govern release are settled during design and development work.
Because the things that generate risk are spread across the whole life span.
Because monitoring in production takes over from the controls applied during development.
Because documentation is handed to supervisory authorities at the moment of launch.

distractor_support.support: The specific design and development processes depend on the functionality and the AI technologies that are intended to be used for the AI system.
distractor_support.why_wrong: Release criteria are one item inside development process guidance and do not explain why attention continues after shipping.

distractor_support.support: At the minimum this should include system and performance monitoring, repairs, updates and support.
